speaker: nora
headline: THE SYSTEM MUST CLOSE ITS OWN LOOP.
deck: The episode ends where governance begins: with the obligation to turn signal into response, response into result and result into durable trust.
quote: A system becomes credible when the public no longer has to guess whether anyone is still carrying the promise.
facts: Responsibility remains visible after the announcement.
Failures trigger correction rather than disappearance.
Delivery reaches the intended person or place.
The result can be checked independently.
takeaway: The final test is institutional memory: can the system keep carrying the obligation until the public can see the result?
